newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 511,900 MT exceeded the previous week by 47 percent and the 4-week average by 29 percent.

Major increases for Japan (165,600 MT), South Korea (101,400 MT), Taiwan (83,600 MT), Spain (72,800 MT, includes 2,500 new sales and 70,500 destination changes), and Belgium (61,900 MT includes 2,900 new sales and 59,000 destination changes) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (228,600 MT). Reductions of 50,000 MT in optional origin sales resulted as origins other than the United States were declared for sales to China.

Exports of 960,200 MT were two and one-eighth times the previous week and 50 percent above the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (164,600 MT), Spain (127,800 MT), Japan (126,800 MT), and Mexico (104,300 MT).
